user.title: Connect to Domoticz
user.description:
Connect to the Domoticz JSON API. This integration syncs device state as read-only Home Assistant entities.

To sync only selected devices, create a dedicated user in Domoticz (Setup -> Users), assign devices to that user using 'Set Devices', and use those credentials here.

data_description.username: Optional. Use a dedicated Domoticz user to limit which devices are synced.

abort.already_configured: This Domoticz instance is already configured.

init.title: Domoticz Sync options
init.description:
Use these credentials when configuring the companion plugin in Domoticz.

Link ID: `{link_id}`

Pairing key: `{pairing_key}`

Keep the pairing key private. It is specific to this connection and is not your Home Assistant password or access token.
